# sylve_vm_network (Resource)

A NIC attached to a sylve_vm beyond its create-time first NIC (sylve_vm's own switch_name/switch_emulation_type/mac_id). Unlike sylve_vm_storage, no shutoff requirement -- NIC attach/detach/update work on a running VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An additional NIC beyond the VM's create-time first one. No shutoff
# requirement -- unlike sylve_vm_storage, this works on a running VM.
resource "sylve_vm_network" "extra_nic" {
  rid         = sylve_vm.example.rid
  switch_name = "lan"
  emulation   = "virtio"
  # mac_id = sylve_network_object.example.id # omit to let Sylve auto-generate one
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emulation` (String) NIC emulation type, e.g. "virtio" (confirmed against a live VM's own network entry -- not the same value space as sylve_vm_storage's "virtio-blk"). Updatable in place.
- `rid` (Number) RID of the sylve_vm to attach this NIC to. Immutable -- moving a NIC between VMs isn't supported by this resource.
- `switch_name` (String) Name of an existing Sylve network switch to attach to. Updatable in place via UpdateNetwork.

### Optional

- `mac_id` (Number) ID of an existing sylve_network_object (type "Mac") to use, instead of letting Sylve auto-generate one. Updatable in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity -- this network entry's own numeric ID (distinct from the VM's rid).
